problem: The cost formula 'tester time per pattern × number of patterns × tester rate' does not say what unit 'tester rate' has, so a student can read it as patterns per hour and get a time instead of a cost in rupees.
fix: Test cost per chip in rupees ≈ (tester time per pattern in hours) × (number of patterns) × (tester rate in rupees per hour). More patterns (higher coverage) means more tester hours and a higher cost per chip.

problem: Section 1 says verification 'runs beside RTL and continues to signoff', but the first exam trap says it 'runs beside every stage'. The two statements disagree, and the figure shows verification hanging off RTL only.
fix: Say it the same way in both places: verification starts at the specification and architecture stage, grows beside RTL and synthesis, and continues to signoff.

problem: 'Tapeout: release masks, fabricate, package, test on the tester' merges four separate steps into the word tapeout. Tapeout is only the handoff of the final layout database for mask making; fabrication, packaging and test come after it.
fix: Tapeout: release the final layout (GDSII) to the mask shop and fab. Fabrication, packaging and tester test follow tapeout.
